recommendations.title: FRESHFARM Penn Quarter Market & Autumn Harvest Stroll
recommendations.who: Downtown D.C. locals, expecting parents, and food lovers (Hosted by FRESHFARM)
recommendations.what: Open-air farmers market featuring Shenandoah Valley orchard apples, warm apple cider, artisan sourdough, seasonal flowers, and local D.C. roasters right in the heart of Penn Quarter.
recommendations.when: Thursdays, 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM (Spring through late Autumn season)
recommendations.where: 8th St NW between D & E Streets NW (Penn Quarter, Downtown D.C.)
recommendations.why: An easy, flat, stroller-friendly afternoon walk in Downtown D.C. to pick up fresh seasonal produce and treats next to the National Portrait Gallery.

recommendations.title: National Gallery of Art — East & West Building Exhibitions & Sculpture Garden
recommendations.who: Art lovers, couples, and families looking for a peaceful indoor/outdoor D.C. outing
recommendations.what: Explore special seasonal exhibitions inside the skylit West Building courtyard (filled with seasonal botanical foliage) and stroll among monumental sculptures around the central fountain.
recommendations.when: Daily, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Free admission, no tickets required)
recommendations.where: Constitution Ave NW between 3rd & 9th Streets NW, Washington, D.C.
recommendations.why: Offers calm, bench-lined galleries, elevator/stroller accessibility, and the Pavilion Café overlooking the changing seasonal trees.

recommendations.title: United States Botanic Garden — Seasonal Conservatory & Bartholdi Fountain Gardens
recommendations.who: Plant enthusiasts, downtown walkers, and families (Hosted by U.S. Botanic Garden)
recommendations.what: Step inside the glass Conservatory tropical & subtropical rooms or relax in the freshly planted seasonal beds at Bartholdi Park just across Independence Ave.
recommendations.when: Daily: Conservatory 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM • Outdoor Gardens Dawn to Dusk (Free)
recommendations.why: One of D.C.’s most serene, climate-controlled sanctuaries with shaded seating and vibrant seasonal blooms.

recommendations.title: Kogod Courtyard & Exhibitions at the National Portrait Gallery / SAAM
recommendations.who: D.C. residents, culture seekers, and parents looking for a relaxed afternoon oasis
recommendations.what: Tour new American portraiture and craft exhibitions, then unwind beneath the iconic Foster + Partners glass canopy in the indoor Kogod Courtyard with shallow water pools and ficus trees.
recommendations.when: Daily, 11:30 AM – 7:00 PM (Open later than Mall museums; Free admission)
recommendations.where: 8th and G Streets NW, Downtown Washington, D.C.
recommendations.why: Open until 7:00 PM every evening right in Downtown D.C., making it ideal for an early-evening stroll or quiet coffee break.
